# My Zini Digital ERP

> All-in-one School, Coaching, and Institution Management ERP software (`https://digitalerp.shop` / `https://myzini.digitalerp.shop`). Registration Fee: ₹100.

## Core Documentation & Pages
- [Home & Registration](https://digitalerp.shop/): Main product overview, 50+ ERP features, pricing plans, and institution registration (₹100 Registration Fee).
- [Live ERP Portal](https://myzini.digitalerp.shop/): School administration dashboard.

## Verified How-To Guides
- [My Zini Digital ERP Payments & Shortcuts Hub Cashier Terminal (Hinglish Guide)](https://digitalerp.shop/blogs/how-to-accept-online-school-fee-payments-myzini-erp.html): Complete Hinglish guide covering Payments & Shortcuts Hub (/shortcut): Fees Payments Records (Class/Roll Fetch & 5 Categories), Staff Salary (18), Family Fees Manage, Apply Other Dues (+ New Fee Type), and Apply Monthly Fees (Duplicate Prevention).
- [My Zini Digital ERP School Transport & Fleet Management (Hinglish Guide)](https://digitalerp.shop/blogs/how-to-manage-school-transport-routes-myzini-erp.html): Complete Hinglish guide covering Transport FLEET (/transport): 3 Live KPIs, Add New Driver modal (Aadhar, DL, Van No., Route, 3 Salary Schemes, Photos), Profile & Students roster, Salary & Ledger, and Cards/Table filters.
- [My Zini Digital ERP Hostel Management & Unified Fee Ledger (Hinglish Guide)](https://digitalerp.shop/blogs/how-to-manage-school-hostel-myzini-erp.html): Complete Hinglish guide covering Hostel Management (/hostel) v2 upgrade pillars (Room & Bed Allocation, Residents Directory, Unified Fees Ledger, Cloud Sync) plus live Hostel fee billing across /students, /finance, /dues-list, and /family-management.
- [My Zini Digital ERP Leave Forms & Management Desk (Hinglish Guide)](https://digitalerp.shop/blogs/how-to-manage-student-staff-leave-forms-myzini-erp.html): Complete Hinglish guide covering Leave Forms DESK (/leave-management): 4 Live KPIs, Cards vs Table view, Status & Role filters, Read Full Application modal (Attachment Proof & Applicant Signature), and Approve/Reject/Reset.
- [My Zini Digital ERP Family Management & Sibling Fee Billing (Hinglish Guide)](https://digitalerp.shop/blogs/how-to-use-family-management-myzini-erp.html): Complete Hinglish guide covering Family Fee Management (/family-management): 7 Live KPIs, Create Family modal, Table & Cards view, Sibling Breakdown (Academic, Prev. Years, Transport, Hostel, Advance), Roll/Dues sorting, and Send WhatsApp Statement.
- [My Zini Digital ERP School Expenses Tracking & Digital Khata (Hinglish Guide)](https://digitalerp.shop/blogs/how-to-record-and-track-school-expenses-myzini-erp.html): Complete Hinglish guide covering Expense Management (/expenses): 4 Live KPI cards (Total Expenditure, This Month, Today's Spend, Avg. Transaction), Add New Expense modal with 9 Quick Suggestions, Search, Date Range, Amount Sort, Category filter chips, and Edit/Delete.
- [My Zini Digital ERP School Announcements & FCM Notice Board (Hinglish Guide)](https://digitalerp.shop/blogs/how-to-create-school-announcements-notices-myzini-erp.html): Complete Hinglish guide covering School Announcements (/announcements): FCM Broadcast Hub, 8 Quick Notice Presets, Compose Announcement (V2/V1, Sound Alert, Message Type), Select Target Classes (623+ students), and Select Students.
- [My Zini Digital ERP Generator Tools Hub (Hinglish Guide)](https://digitalerp.shop/blogs/how-to-use-generator-tools-myzini-erp.html): Complete Hinglish guide covering Generator Tools Hub (/generator-tools): 4-in-1 Fees Dues Bill (5 styles, QR), Family Bills, Student Data Info Sheet, ID Cards, Progress Cards, Admit Cards (17 styles), Custom Marksheet Designer (Canva-style), and Certificates.
- [My Zini Digital ERP Exam Results & Marksheets (Hinglish Guide)](https://digitalerp.shop/blogs/how-to-publish-exam-results-myzini-erp.html): Complete Hinglish guide covering Exam Results Portal (/results), Add New Exam, Passing Criteria, Grade Configuration, Manage / Enter Marks, Completion % (Recorded vs Pending), Edit Marks, and Add Marks.
- [My Zini Digital ERP Assigned RFID Cards & Smart Attendance (Hinglish Guide)](https://digitalerp.shop/blogs/how-to-use-rfid-cards-for-students-myzini-erp.html): Complete Hinglish guide covering Assigned RFID Cards (/assigned-rfid-cards), Device Setup (MACHINE SS TOKEN, Fetch IP, Scanner Polling), Assign RFID Card (Auto Scanned), and Class Assignment List (Assign/Unassign).
- [My Zini Digital ERP Classes, Subjects & Timetable (Hinglish Guide)](https://digitalerp.shop/blogs/how-to-create-and-manage-classes-myzini-erp.html): Complete Hinglish guide covering Academic & Curriculum Management (/classes), 27 Class Standards, 24 Curriculum Subjects, Monthly Tuition Fees, Weekly Off, Class Mentors, and Weekly Academic Timetable (+ Add First Period).
- [My Zini Digital ERP Staff Management & Salary Tracking (Hinglish Guide)](https://digitalerp.shop/blogs/how-to-manage-staff-and-salaries-myzini-erp.html): Complete Hinglish guide covering Staff Management (/staff), Add Staff (Monthly Salary, Daily Absent Fine, 1-Hour Late Fine, RFID Card, Portal Login), Status Filters, Previous Dues, Export (JSON/CSV/XLSX), and Staff Salary Payouts.
- [My Zini Digital ERP Pending Dues List & Fee Reminders (Hinglish Guide)](https://digitalerp.shop/blogs/how-to-track-student-dues-list-myzini-erp.html): Complete Hinglish guide covering Fee Dues Radar (/dues-list), All Classes Defaulters, Exclude Family Sibling Concession, Pending Dues Only / Advance Surplus / All Profiles pills, WhatsApp Automation Setup, and Export CSV.
- [My Zini Digital ERP Fee Collection & Finance (Hinglish Guide)](https://digitalerp.shop/blogs/how-to-manage-fee-collection-finance-myzini-erp.html): Complete Hinglish guide covering Finance Command Center (/finance), Today's Inflow, Total Debt, Jan-Dec Class-wise Matrix, 7 Department Tabs, and Payments & Shortcuts Hub (/shortcut Cashier Terminal).
- [My Zini Digital ERP Daily Attendance & Reports (Hinglish Guide)](https://digitalerp.shop/blogs/how-to-take-attendance-and-view-reports-myzini-erp.html): Complete Hinglish guide covering Take Attendance (/attendance), Only Active Students, Customize Notice Templates, Staff Attendance (/staff-attendance), Exit Attendance, and Date-Aware Attendance Reports (/attendance-report).
- [My Zini Digital ERP School Dashboard & Quick Actions (Hinglish Guide)](https://digitalerp.shop/blogs/how-to-use-school-dashboard-quick-actions-myzini-erp.html): Complete Hinglish guide covering Live Sync KPIs, Today's Attendance Overview, 8 Quick Actions, Class-wise Attendance, Inactive Students filter, Financial Overview, Staff Pending Balances, and 6 Analytics Charts.
- [How to Use Student Management in My Zini Digital ERP](https://digitalerp.shop/blogs/how-to-use-student-management-myzini-erp.html): Step-by-step guide covering student search, class filtering, Add Student form fields (personal, parent, hostel, transport, fees), Upload Bulk, and Export (JSON, CSV, Excel).
